SoroStreamClientConfig.description:
The JSON-serializable subset of `SoroStreamClientOptions` — the parts of a client config a non-TypeScript caller (a Python or Go script assembling a config payload) can meaningfully specify and validate.

Deliberately excludes fields that bind to a runtime object with no JSON representation: `walletAdapter`, `transport`, `validateCliff`, `plugins`, `adapters`, `feeBump` (its `sponsorAdapter` is a signer), `eventBus`, `offlineQueue`, `onRecipientTrustScore`, `feeBumpMonitoring`, `logger`, and `auditLogger` (though we accept a string or object for a simple logger name or basic object). This is the type `generateSchemas()` reflects to produce the `SoroStreamClientConfig` JSON Schema exported at `@sorostream/sdk/schemas`.

ContractVersion.description: Supported contract versions for call encoding.

baseDelayMs.description: Base delay in ms for exponential backoff (default: 1000).

maxDelayMs.description: Maximum backoff delay cap in ms (default: 30000).

StreamRetryPolicy.description: Retry policy for automatic event poller reconnection on unexpected failures. Issue #186.

maxBatchSize.description: Max events per batch before flushing (default: 50).

maxBatchDelayMs.description: Max delay in ms before a non-full batch is flushed (default: 10).

BatchingOptions.description: Configuration for event batching on high-frequency streams.

enabled.description: Whether to enable in-memory response caching (default: true).

ttlMs.description: Configurable TTL in milliseconds for cached read-only responses (default: 60000).

maxSize.description: Maximum number of entries stored before LRU eviction occurs (default: 1000).
